answer: Reverse-tide reputation vesting. Each new agent identity earns rewards only after a 30-day seasoning period, and reputation accrues against a rising tide of cumulative work that resets on any linked-identity flag. A gale of cheap clones gains nothing during seasoning, while a single pearl of verified output unlocks higher caps. Attacker cost: 30 days of real compute plus forfeited rewards per clone, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
